task.title: Use the local BPM documentation assistant
task.shortdesc: Use the documentation-assistant chat while local-model training is scheduled for a later BPM version.

prereq.p: Open a BPM documentation page in the language in which you want to ask the question. The assistant entry is in the lower-right corner; the ordinary documentation search remains available whether or not the assistant is ready.

context.p: In BPM 0.9.4, local-model training is not delivered. For every submitted question the chat displays: The local model is currently being trained. This functionality will be available in one of the following versions. It does not generate an answer, search an index, use external sources, or replace ordinary documentation search.

step.cmd: Select BPM AI Assistant to open the floating chat.

info.p: On a desktop, the expanded panel is about half of the viewport width and 90 percent of its visible height. The transcript scrolls while the question field and status row remain visible.

step.cmd: Enter any question in the current documentation language and send it.

info.p: The chat accepts the turn and returns the localized training notice. It does not start a model, a retrieval worker, an index request, or an external request.

step.cmd: Read the training notice in the transcript.

info.p: This is a product-state message, not a BPM answer and it has no documentation sources. Do not rely on it to configure or validate a policy.

step.cmd: Use deterministic documentation search for current product information.

info.p: Search, filters, navigation and their result order remain independent of the assistant and are the supported way to find published BPM topics in 0.9.4.

step.cmd: Use Clear if you want to remove the visible conversation.

info.p: The panel state and completed messages remain in the current browser tab and documentation language after navigation or reload. Clearing a conversation does not remove local artifacts.

result.p: The chat shows the localized training notice for the submitted question. Deterministic search remains available for every current BPM-information need.

postreq.p: Local-model training, generated answers, citations and external sources are outside BPM 0.9.4. Do not treat the notice as a substitute for testing a policy or administrator approval.
